## Class 01 Course introduction and symmetry activity

For symmetry activity focus on just $D_3$ and and make sure they know the flix axes do not move with the shape. Maybe $r_c$ and $r_cc$, have outside labeled with ABC and flips are $f_A$, $f_B$, $f_C$ and rotations are $r_c$ and $r_cc$.  Then have them do the multiplication table for $D_3$ and then ask them to find the inverse of each element.  Then have them do the same for $D_4$.  Highlight you can reverse every move and when you compose it is already one on the list.
